SELECT 
  CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) as utc_order_date,
  COUNT(*) as web_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
  AND status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)
ORDER BY utc_order_date

  status,
  COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status
